message.content: Based on the conversations between Li Hua and Adam Smith, Li Hua has plans to celebrate Chinese Lunar New Year. Specifically, Li Hua mentions her plans to "enjoy some delicious food and do a little bit of traveling if I can." This indicates that she intends to travel to experience local festivities during the Lunar New Year celebrations. No specific date is mentioned, but given that it is 2026 and the conversations occurred on January 19th, it is likely that the celebrations are taking place in early 2026. The exact date of celebration would depend on the lunar calendar, which differs from the Gregorian calendar used in Western cultures.
